properties.title: M 6.5 - 14 km WNW of Reuleuet, Indonesia

contents.bytes: At least 104 people killed, 1,273 injured, 85,256 displaced and 18,752 buildings destroyed or damaged in Aceh. Felt (VIII) in Kabupaten Pidie Jaya, Kecamatan Dewantara and at Sigli; (VI) at Bireun and Samalanga; (V) at Lhokseumawe and Banda Aceh; (IV) at Meulaboh. Also felt at Langsa, Medan, Sabang and Sibolga. Felt (III) at George Town, Kuah and Sungai Ara, Malaysia. Also felt at Alor Setar, Butterworth, Petaling Jaya, Tanjung Bunga and Tanjung Tokong. Felt (III) at Kathu, Phangnga and Phuket, Thailand. Also felt at Bangkok, Kantang and Trang.
